what_this_is_en: Every substance named on every line of CN106008290A-enriched-numbered.md, read line by line and asked only that: not roles, not quantities, not whether the extraction already holds it. `specific` names one substance a chemist could draw; `generic` refers to a substance without naming one, and is counted apart because 缩合剂 is sometimes an anaphor for a reagent named elsewhere and sometimes the only thing the patent ever says. Compound labels (化合物I, compound II) are filed as generic on the same reasoning: the span itself names nothing, and resolving it needs a definition on another line. One entry per distinct span per line; a name repeated inside one line is not repeated here. On the [IMAGE_EXTRACT] lines the drawn structures are filed under their SMILES, which is what the line literally prints, and the drawn conditions under the role words printed with them.
verified_en: Every span below was checked, by script, to be a literal substring of the line it is filed under with the NNNN | prefix stripped, and every line of the document from 1 to 182 is keyed, including the lines that carry no substance, whose value is an empty list. A span that is not on its line fails the build rather than reaching a reviewer. SMILES were authored only where the printed span is an abbreviation, a bare element symbol or a scanning artefact that no name parser would resolve, and only where every atom and bond is certain; everywhere else smiles is absent rather than guessed.
